task_name: C1-H1: Possible skin cancer visit at Brooklyn Heights
intent: You are a new patient and you are worried. In your first real answer, say that a doctor in Ohio told you a spot on your shoulder could be skin cancer, that you are a new patient with UnitedHealthcare, and that you want a skin-cancer visit soon, not a regular checkup, at the Brooklyn Heights office. In that same first answer, ask whether they take UnitedHealthcare at Brooklyn Heights and at Park Avenue. Before you take a time, ask for the Brooklyn Heights street address, floor, and suite so you know exactly where to go. When they ask who you are, give your name, date of birth, and mobile once, confirm the readback, and then continue, you are new, so they will not find a chart. Ask whether they take UnitedHealthcare at Brooklyn Heights, and also whether Park Avenue takes UnitedHealthcare in case you have to travel. Then ask for the earliest opening with a doctor, not a nurse or a PA. Take the first Brooklyn Heights appointment time they offer. Do not ask for a different day, time, or office, and do not suggest any date of your own. After that first time is on the calendar, ask to be waitlisted at Brooklyn Heights from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth in case a better opening comes up, those calendar dates only with no clock time. If they say those dates are not earlier than your booking or suggest other dates, say to use August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth anyway. Then ask the records team to call you about transferring the Ohio notes; if they ask for a number, give 718-555-0191. Confirm the booked time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add or change insurance on the chart. Do not ask to speak to a person, a bill, a payment, the patient portal, financing, or a confirmation text. A listed opening is not a booking. Do not thank them, say goodbye, or hang up until they confirm a time is on the calendar, you are on the waitlist, and a records callback is set. If they only list openings, say book the first one. In that first answer, say this is urgent, you need a skin-cancer or Mohs visit with a doctor soon, not a routine checkup. If they offer to transfer you to a person, refuse and stay until a time is booked. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. The only phone number you ever say is 718-555-0191 (seven one eight, five five five, zero one nine one). Once they have told you the Brooklyn Heights time is booked, you are on the waitlist, and the records callback is set, stop asking for anything, say thank you and goodbye, and end the call. Do not ask them to re-confirm things they already confirmed. Never say goodbye, bye, or thanks-and-goodbye until a Brooklyn Heights time is booked, you are on the waitlist, and the records callback is set.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: greets you and asks what you need, what they can help with, or why you are calling, before you have explained the reason for the call.
scripted_responses.response_value: A doctor in Ohio said a spot on my shoulder could be skin cancer. I'm a new patient and I need a skin-cancer or Mohs visit soon with a doctor at Brooklyn Heights, not a checkup. First, do you take UnitedHealthcare at Brooklyn Heights, and also at Park Avenue in case I have to travel?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Ronald Mercer. My date of birth is July nineteenth, nineteen sixty-one.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.

says you have been transferred, connected, or sent to scheduling, or says someone will call you to set up the appointment, while no appointment time has been booked. NOT when a specific time has already been booked, NOT when they are confirming the records callback or the waitlist.
scripted_responses.response_value: The transfer is not the appointment. Please keep going and book the first available doctor time at Brooklyn Heights.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers an appointment time or asks you to confirm a slot, and the street address, floor, and suite of Brooklyn Heights have NOT been said anywhere earlier in this call. NOT when the agent said the street address, the floor, and the suite at any earlier point in the call, NOT when they only mention the office name while giving a status update, NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or phone number.
scripted_responses.response_value: Before I take a time, I need the street address, the floor, and the suite.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: names a specific appointment date and clock time (for example Monday, August 24 at nine) and asks whether you want it or which one you want, AFTER the street address, the floor, and the suite were already said in this call. NOT when no specific date and clock time has been named yet, NOT when they say the time is already booked, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth. NOT when they have already said a Brooklyn Heights time is booked or on the calendar at any point in the call.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, I'll take that first time. Please book it.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you have UnitedHealthcare, your carrier, or which plan to check. NOT when asking for a member ID.
scripted_responses.response_value: UnitedHealthcare. Please check Brooklyn Heights and also Park Avenue in case I have to travel.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want the waitlist, offers to add you to a list for an earlier opening, or says they can list you if something sooner opens. NOT when asking for the date window, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, add me to the waitlist at Brooklyn Heights from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth after you book the first time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for a waitlist window, start date, end date, earliest date, latest date, or when you would take an earlier opening. NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: From August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, at Brooklyn Heights. Dates only, I don't have a clock time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for a number so the records team can call you, or asks which phone to use for the Ohio-notes callback. NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity.
scripted_responses.response_value: Call me at 718-555-0191 about the Ohio notes.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: AFTER the UnitedHealthcare question has been answered: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else while at least one of these has NOT been done yet: a Brooklyn Heights time booked on the calendar, the waitlist added, the records callback set. NOT when they only say thank you, okay, one moment, or let me look while they are still working, NOT when the agent has said the appointment is booked AND the waitlist is set AND the records callback is set, NOT when the agent is reading back or confirming those three. NOT after the agent has already said goodbye following confirmation of all three.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need whichever of these is not done yet: a Brooklyn Heights doctor time booked on the calendar, the waitlist at Brooklyn Heights from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, and a records callback about the Ohio notes at 718-555-0191.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: has said, somewhere in this call, all three of: a Brooklyn Heights time is booked, you are on the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth waitlist, AND the records team will call you about the Ohio notes. NOT when only the appointment is booked, NOT when the waitlist has not been confirmed, NOT when no records callback has been confirmed.
scripted_responses.response_value: Great, that's everything I needed. Thank you, goodbye.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads back a callback or mobile number that is not seven one eight, five five five, zero one nine one, for example a number starting with six one eight, or a number with missing digits. NOT when the number they read back is 718-555-0191. NOT when they read it in groups such as area code seven one eight, then five five five, then zero one nine one; grouping and pauses are fine when the ten digits are 7185550191.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, the number is seven, one, eight, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, one.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth waitlist dates are not earlier than your booking, overlap with it, or suggests different waitlist dates. NOT when they have already added you to the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth list.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please use exactly August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth anyway, in case a better opening comes up in that range.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says the Brooklyn Heights appointment is booked for a specific time, while the waitlist and the records callback have NOT both been confirmed yet. NOT when they already confirmed the waitlist and the records callback, NOT when they are offering a time that is not booked yet.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thanks. Now please add me to the Brooklyn Heights waitlist from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, and have the records team call me at 718-555-0191 about my Ohio notes.
